scripts.build: tsc -b packages/spec packages/sql packages/duckdb-engine packages/js packages/grid packages/mcp packages/vscode packages/cli && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/compile-react.mjs packages/grid && npm run build -w vastgrid-mcp && node packages/vscode/scripts/build.mjs && node packages/cli/scripts/build-app.mjs && node packages/notebook/scripts/build.mjs
